item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Fullscreen triangle 2026-07-27 Commit: dc0422d Since per-pixel voxel ray tracing is expensive work, the fullscreen quad is replaced with a fullscreen triangle to avoid duplicated ray tracing along the quad edge. This is a good blog post explaining the method. While it’s more optimal, there is no measurable difference at the granularity used here. 2-level DDA 2026-07-24 Commit: ed4004c An additional brick grid is introduced, indicating whether an 8 x 8 x 8 group of voxels (a brick) is occupied.
